# Bruinet API changes

What a project using Bruinet must change, per change. `Find` is a regex for consumer code
(`*.cs`, and where noted `*.feature`, `*.steps`, `*.config`, `*.json`).

## Made

Newest first. Apply oldest first.

| Commit | Change | Find | Write instead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R2-T17 | A refusal by the platform or the app (a pattern that refused, the game refusing an action, a picker with no such item, Windows refusing a key) is `Bruinet.Core.Exceptions.ActionRefusedException`, a `BruinetException`, no longer `InvalidOperationException` | `catch \(InvalidOperationException` around a control call | `catch (ActionRefusedException …)`; an `InvalidOperationException` is now a fault |
| R2-T13 | `Bruinet.Uat.UatControlAssertions` is deleted: its four bare catches made `AssertAbsentOrHidden` and its waits pass on any error, and nothing called it | `UatControlAssertions\.` | The control's own `AssertVisible(false)`, `WaitVisible(…)`, `AssertExists(false)` |
